units.zh: 梁書卷第八 列傳第二
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume Eight, Biographies, Second
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 8, Biographies 2

units.zh: 昭明太子 哀太子 愍懷太子
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming; the Grieving Crown Prince; the Lamenting Crown Prince
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming; Crown Prince Ai; Crown Prince Minhuai

units.zh: 昭明太子統字德施，高祖長子也。
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming, Tong, styled Deshi, was Gaozu's eldest son.
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming, Tong, styled Deshi, was Gaozu's eldest son.

units.zh: 母曰丁貴嬪。
units.en: His mother was Honored Concubine Ding.
units.literal: His mother was Honored Concubine Ding.

units.zh: 初，高祖未有男，義師起，太子以齊中興元年九月生于襄陽。
units.en: At first Gaozu had no sons; when the righteous army arose, the crown prince was born at Xiangyang in the ninth month of Qi Zhongxing 1.
units.literal: At first Gaozu had no sons; when the righteous army arose, the crown prince was born at Xiangyang in the ninth month of Qi Zhongxing 1.

units.zh: 高祖旣受禪，有司奏立儲副，高祖以天下始定，百度多闕，未之許也。
units.en: After Gaozu accepted the abdication, the offices memorialized asking to establish an heir. Because the realm had only just been settled and many institutions were still lacking, Gaozu did not yet approve it.
units.literal: After Gaozu accepted the abdication, the offices memorialized asking to establish an heir. Because the realm had only just been settled and many institutions were still lacking, Gaozu did not yet approve it.

units.zh: 羣臣固請，天監元年十一月，立爲皇太子。
units.en: The assembled ministers insisted, and in the eleventh month of Tianjian 1 he was established as crown prince.
units.literal: The assembled ministers insisted, and in the eleventh month of Tianjian 1 he was established as crown prince.

units.zh: 時太子年幼，依舊居於內，拜東宮官屬文武，皆入直永福省。
units.en: At the time the crown prince was young and continued, as before, to live inside the palace; the civil and military officials appointed to the Eastern Palace all entered on duty in Yongfu Office.
units.literal: At the time the crown prince was young and continued, as before, to live inside the palace; the civil and military officials appointed to the Eastern Palace all entered on duty in Yongfu Office.

units.zh: 太子生而聰叡，三歲受《孝經》、《論語》，五歲遍讀五經，悉能諷誦。
units.en: The crown prince was bright from birth; at three he studied the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects, at five he had read the Five Classics through and could recite them all.
units.literal: From birth the crown prince was clever and perspicacious; at three he received the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects, at five he read through the Five Classics in full and could all chant them from memory.

units.zh: 五年五月庚戌，始出居東宮。
units.en: In year five, on the fifth month's gengxu day, he first took up residence in the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: In the fifth year, fifth month, day gengxu, he first went out to dwell in the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 太子性仁孝，自出宮，恒思戀不樂。
units.en: By nature the crown prince was humane and filial; once he left the palace grounds he pined constantly and was never at ease.
units.literal: The crown prince by nature was humane and filial; from leaving the palace he constantly thought longingly and was unhappy.

units.zh: 高祖知之，每五日一朝，多便留永福省，或五日三日乃還宮。
units.en: Gaozu knew it: court was held every five days, and he often kept the heir at Yongfu Ward—or only let him return after three or five days.
units.literal: Gaozu knew this; every fifth day he attended court once, often keeping him at Yongfu Ward, sometimes five days or three before returning to the palace.

units.zh: 八年九月，於壽安殿講《孝經》，盡通大義。
units.en: In the ninth month of year eight he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety in Shou'an Hall and mastered its main meaning.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year, at Shou'an Hall he lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and fully penetrated its great meaning.

units.zh: 講畢，親臨釋奠于國學。
units.en: When the lecture ended he personally offered the libation sacrifice at the Imperial Academy.
units.literal: When the lecture ended, he personally performed the libation sacrifice at the Imperial Academy.

units.zh: 十四年正月朔旦，高祖臨軒，冠太子于太極殿。
units.en: At dawn on New Year's Day of year fourteen Gaozu faced the hall and capped the crown prince in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
units.literal: On the first morning of the first month of the fourteenth year, Gaozu faced the hall and capped the crown prince in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

units.zh: 舊制，太子著遠遊冠，金蟬翠緌纓；
units.en: By old custom the crown prince wore the Far-Wandering cap with golden cicada and emerald tassels and ribbons;
units.literal: By old regulation the crown prince wore the Far-Wandering cap, with golden cicada and emerald tassels and ribbons;

units.zh: 至是，詔加金博山。
units.en: now an edict added the golden Boshan ornament.
units.literal: at this time an edict added the golden Boshan ornament.

units.zh: 太子美姿貌，善舉止。
units.en: The crown prince was handsome in face and graceful in bearing.
units.literal: The crown prince had a fine countenance and graceful bearing.

units.zh: 讀書數行並下，過目皆憶。
units.en: He read several lines at a glance and remembered whatever passed his eyes.
units.literal: In reading, several lines came down together; what passed his eye he all remembered.

units.zh: 每游宴祖道，賦詩至十數韻。
units.en: At feasts or parting rites he would compose poems in as many as ten rhyme groups.
units.literal: Whenever at feasts or parting rites he composed poetry to as many as ten rhyme groups.

units.zh: 或命作劇韻賦之，皆屬思便成，無所點易。
units.en: Sometimes ordered to improvise rhymed verse, he finished at once as thought came, without a single revision.
units.literal: Sometimes he was ordered to make impromptu rhyme compositions and would complete them as thought flowed, with nothing to change.

units.zh: 高祖大弘佛教，親自講說；
units.en: Gaozu greatly promoted Buddhism and lectured on it himself;
units.literal: Gaozu greatly spread Buddhism and personally lectured on it;

units.zh: 太子亦崇信三寶，遍覽衆經。
units.en: the crown prince also revered the Three Treasures and read through all the sutras.
units.literal: the crown prince also deeply believed in the Three Treasures and read through all the sutras.

units.zh: 乃於宮內別立慧義殿，專爲法集之所。
units.en: He then built Huiyi Hall within the palace, set apart solely for Dharma gatherings.
units.literal: He then within the palace separately established Huiyi Hall, devoted solely to assemblies of the Dharma.

units.zh: 招引名僧，談論不絕。
units.en: He drew in eminent monks, and doctrinal discussion never ceased.
units.literal: He drew in famous monks; discussions never ceased.

units.zh: 太子自立二諦、法身義，並有新意。
units.en: The crown prince himself framed doctrines of the Two Truths and the Dharma-body, each with fresh insight.
units.literal: The crown prince himself set forth doctrines of the Two Truths and Dharma-body, both with fresh meaning.

units.zh: 普通元年四月，甘露降于慧義殿，咸以爲至德所感焉。
units.en: In the fourth month of Putong year one sweet dew fell on Huiyi Hall; all deemed it a response to supreme virtue.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Putong, sweet dew fell on Huiyi Hall; all took it as a response to supreme virtue.

units.zh: 三年十一月，始興王憺薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year three Prince Dan of Shixing died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, Prince Dan of Shixing died.

units.zh: 舊事，以東宮禮絕傍親，書翰並依常儀。
units.en: Formerly, because Eastern Palace ritual severs collateral kin, letters and memorials all followed ordinary usage.
units.literal: By former precedent, because Eastern Palace ritual cuts off collateral kin, letters and memorials all followed ordinary rites.

units.zh: 太子意以爲疑，命僕劉孝綽議其事。
units.en: The crown prince found this doubtful and ordered his secretary Liu Xiaochuo to deliberate it.
units.literal: The crown prince thought this doubtful and ordered his secretary Liu Xiaochuo to deliberate the matter.

units.zh: 孝綽議曰：「案張鏡撰《東宮儀記》，稱『三朝發哀者，逾月不舉樂；
units.en: Xiaochuo wrote: "Zhang Jing's Eastern Palace Ritual Record says, 'For mourning begun at the three audiences, for more than a month music is not performed;
units.literal: Xiaochuo's deliberation said: "According to Zhang Jing's compilation Eastern Palace Ritual Record, it states, 'For those who begin mourning at the three audiences, for more than a month music is not performed;

units.zh: 鼓吹寢奏，服限亦然』。
units.en: drums and pipes cease, and the dress limit is the same.'"
units.literal: drums and pipes cease performance, and the limit on dress is likewise.'"

units.zh: 尋傍絕之義，義在去服，服雖可奪，情豈無悲？
units.en: The sense of severing collateral kin is that mourning dress ends; dress may be removed, but feeling cannot be stripped of grief.
units.literal: Seeking the meaning of cutting off collateral kin, the meaning lies in removing mourning dress; dress may be stripped away, but can feeling be without grief?

units.zh: 鐃歌輟奏，良亦爲此。
units.en: Halting gongs and songs is truly for this reason as well.
units.literal: The striking of gongs and songs ceasing performance is truly also for this.

units.zh: 旣有悲情，宜稱兼慕，卒哭之後，依常舉樂，稱悲竟，此理例相符。
units.en: Where grief remains, one should call it combined mourning; after the wailing sacrifice music may resume as usual, grief being ended—principle and precedent agree.
units.literal: Since there is feeling of grief, one should style it "combined mourning"; after the wailing sacrifice, follow custom in performing music, calling grief ended—this principle and precedent accord.

units.zh: 謂猶應稱兼慕，至卒哭。」
units.en: He held that combined mourning should still be named until the wailing sacrifice."
units.literal: It is held that one should still style it combined mourning until the wailing sacrifice."

units.zh: 僕射徐勉、左率周舍、家令陸襄並同孝綽議。
units.en: Vice Director Xu Mian, Left Leader Zhou She, and Household Intendant Lu Xiang all sided with Xiaochuo.
units.literal: Vice Director Xu Mian, Left Leader Zhou She, and Household Intendant Lu Xiang all agreed with Xiaochuo's deliberation.

units.zh: 太子令曰：「張鏡《儀記》云『依《士禮》，終服月稱慕悼』。
units.en: The crown prince ordered: "Zhang Jing's Ritual Record says, 'Per the Rites of the Scholar, after full mourning for a month one styles mourning tribute.
units.literal: The crown prince's order said: "Zhang Jing's Ritual Record says, 'According to the Rites of the Scholar, after full mourning for a month one styles mourning tribute.

units.zh: 又云『凡三朝發哀者，逾月不舉樂』。
units.en: It also says, 'For all who begin mourning at the three audiences, for more than a month music is not performed.'"
units.literal: It also says, 'For all who begin mourning at the three audiences, for more than a month music is not performed.'"

units.zh: 劉僕議，云『傍絕之義，義在去服，服雖可奪，情豈無悲，卒哭之後，依常舉樂，稱悲竟，此理例相符』。
units.en: Secretary Liu says, 'Severing collateral kin means mourning dress ends; dress may go, but grief cannot; after the wailing sacrifice music resumes as usual, grief ended—principle and precedent agree.'"
units.literal: Secretary Liu's deliberation says, 'The meaning of cutting off collateral kin lies in removing mourning dress; dress may be stripped away, but can feeling be without grief? After the wailing sacrifice, follow custom in performing music, calling grief ended—this principle and precedent accord.'"

units.zh: 尋情悲之說，非止卒哭之後，緣情爲論，此自難一也。
units.en: On feeling grief, the issue is not only after the wailing sacrifice; arguing from feeling alone, this is hard to unify.
units.literal: Seeking the doctrine of feeling grief, it is not only after the wailing sacrifice; taking feeling as the argument, this itself is hard to unify.

units.zh: 用張鏡之舉樂，棄張鏡之稱悲，一鏡之言，取捨有異，此自難二也。
units.en: To take Zhang Jing's music while dropping his grief styling—in one author's words the choices conflict; this is the second difficulty.
units.literal: To use Zhang Jing's performing of music while abandoning Zhang Jing's styling of grief—in one mirror's words, taking and discarding differ; this itself is hard, second.

units.zh: 陸家令止云『多歷年所』，恐非事證；
units.en: Lu the Household Intendant only cited 'many years'—I fear that is not proof;
units.literal: Household Intendant Lu only said 'for many years'—I fear this is not evidence of the matter;

units.zh: 雖復累稔所用，意常未安。
units.en: though long in use, the mind has never been easy with it.
units.literal: though used for accumulated years, in mind one has never been at ease.

units.zh: 近亦常經以此問外，由來立意，謂猶應有慕悼之言。
units.en: Lately this has often been asked outside court; from the first the intent has been that mourning tribute should still be named.
units.literal: Recently one has also often passed this question outward; from the outset the established intent has been that there should still be words of mourning tribute.

units.zh: 張豈不知舉樂爲大，稱悲事小；
units.en: Surely Zhang knew performing music was the greater matter and styling grief the lesser.
units.literal: How could Zhang not know that performing music is great and styling grief a small matter?

units.zh: 所以用小而忽大，良亦有以。
units.en: He used the lesser and set aside the greater for good reason.
units.literal: The reason for using the small and neglecting the great truly also has its grounds.

units.zh: 至如元正六佾，事爲國章；
units.en: As for New Year's six rows of dancers, the affair is a state statute;
units.literal: As for the first of the year with six rows of dancers, the affair is a statute of the state;

units.zh: 雖情或未安，而禮不可廢。
units.en: though feeling may be uneasy, ritual cannot be set aside.
units.literal: though feeling may not be at ease, ritual cannot be abandoned.

units.zh: 鐃吹軍樂，比之亦然。
units.en: Gongs, pipes, and military music stand on the same footing.
units.literal: Gongs, pipes, and military music are comparable in the same way.

units.zh: 書疏方之，事則成小，差可緣心。
units.en: Letters and memorials are the smaller affair and may somewhat follow the heart.
units.literal: Compared with letters and memorials, the affair is then smaller and may somewhat follow the heart.

units.zh: 聲樂自外，書疏自內，樂自他，書自己。
units.en: Music comes from outside; letters come from within—music from others, letters from oneself.
units.literal: Music and sound come from without; letters and memorials come from within; music from others, letters from oneself.

units.zh: 劉僕射之議，卽情未安。
units.en: Vice Director Liu's view leaves feeling uneasy.
units.literal: Vice Director Liu's deliberation—feeling is not at ease.

units.zh: 可令諸賢更共詳衷。」
units.en: Let the worthies deliberate further to the end."
units.literal: Let the various worthies together deliberate further to the end."

units.zh: 司農卿明山賓、步兵校尉朱异議，稱「慕悼之解，宜終服月」。
units.en: Director of Agriculture Ming Shanbin and Colonel of Footsoldiers Zhu Yi deliberated, stating, "The interpretation of mourning tribute should run through the month of full mourning."
units.literal: Director of Agriculture Ming Shanbin and Colonel of Footsoldiers Zhu Yi deliberated, stating, "The interpretation of mourning tribute should run through the month of full mourning."

units.zh: 於是令付典書遵用，以爲永凖。
units.en: The order was then handed to the Director of Documents for permanent use as standard.
units.literal: Thereupon the order was handed to the Director of Documents to follow in use, taken as everlasting standard.

units.zh: 七年十一月，貴嬪有疾，太子還永福省，朝夕侍疾，衣不解帶。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year seven the honored consort fell ill; the crown prince returned to Yongfu Ward and tended her day and night without loosening his belt.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year the honored consort fell ill; the crown prince returned to Yongfu Ward, attending her morning and evening, his clothes' belt never loosened.

units.zh: 及薨，步從喪還宮，至殯，水漿不入口，每哭輒慟絕。
units.en: When she died he walked behind the coffin back to the palace; through the lying-in-state he took no food or drink, and each cry ended in collapse.
units.literal: When she died he walked behind the coffin back to the palace; until the lying-in-state he took no food or drink, and each lament ended in fainting.

units.zh: 高祖遣中書舍人顧協宣旨曰：「毀不滅性，聖人之制。
units.en: Gaozu sent Palace Secretary Gu Xie with an edict: "Self-destruction does not extinguish nature—the sage's rule.
units.literal: Gaozu sent Palace Secretary Gu Xie to proclaim the intent: "Destroying oneself does not extinguish one's nature—this is the sage's regulation.

units.zh: 《禮》，不勝喪比於不孝。
units.en: The Rites say failing to bear mourning ranks with unfilial conduct.
units.literal: The Rites say that not bearing up under mourning is classed with unfilial conduct.

units.zh: 有我在，那得自毀如此！
units.en: While I still live, how can you destroy yourself so!
units.literal: While I am here, how can you destroy yourself thus!

units.zh: 可卽強進飲食。」
units.en: Force yourself to eat and drink at once."
units.literal: You must at once force yourself to take food and drink."

units.zh: 太子奉勅，乃進數合。
units.en: The crown prince obeyed and took a few mouthfuls.
units.literal: The crown prince received the command and then took several mouthfuls.

units.zh: 自是至葬，日進麥粥一升。
units.en: From then until burial he took only one sheng of wheat porridge a day.
units.literal: From then until the burial he daily took one sheng of wheat porridge.

units.zh: 高祖又勅曰：「聞汝所進過少，轉就羸瘵。
units.en: Gaozu commanded again: "I hear you eat too little and grow wasted and ill.
units.literal: Gaozu again commanded: "I hear what you take is too little and you are turning wasted and ill.

units.zh: 我比更無餘病，正爲汝如此，胸中亦圮塞成疾。
units.en: I have no other sickness—only because of you my chest clogs into illness.
units.literal: I lately have no other illness—only because of you thus does my breast also clog and become diseased.

units.zh: 故應強加饘粥，不使我恒爾懸心。」
units.en: So force more gruel and porridge on yourself and do not keep my heart always suspended."
units.literal: Therefore you should force yourself to take more gruel and porridge, and not make me always hang my heart thus."

units.zh: 雖屢奉勅勸逼，日止一溢，不嚐菜果之味。
units.en: Though repeatedly urged by edict, daily he took only one yi and tasted no vegetables or fruit.
units.literal: Though repeatedly receiving commands to urge and compel, daily he stopped at one yi and did not taste vegetables or fruit.

units.zh: 體素壯，腰帶十圍，至是減削過半。
units.en: His frame had been sturdy, his waist ten encirclements; by then more than half was gone.
units.literal: His constitution had been robust, his waist belt ten encirclements; by then it was reduced by more than half.

units.zh: 每入朝，士庶見者莫不下泣。
units.en: Whenever he entered court, officials and commoners who saw him wept.
units.literal: Whenever he entered court, scholars and commoners who saw him none failed to weep below.

units.zh: 太子自加元服，高祖便使省萬機，內外百司，奏事者填塞於前。
units.en: After his capping Gaozu had him review myriad affairs; memorialists from every office filled the forecourt.
units.literal: From the time the crown prince himself added the capping ceremony, Gaozu had him review the myriad affairs; within and without the hundred offices, those memorializing filled the space before him.

units.zh: 太子明於庶事，纖毫必曉，每所奏有謬誤及巧妄，皆卽就辯析，示其可否，徐令改正，未嘗彈糾一人。
units.en: The crown prince knew common affairs down to the finest strand; whenever a memorial erred or lied, he analyzed it on the spot, showed what stood, ordered correction without haste, and never punished anyone.
units.literal: The crown prince was clear on common affairs; the finest strand he always understood. Whenever what was memorialized had error or crafty falsehood, he at once went to analyze and show what might or might not be so, slowly ordered correction, and never once punished a person.

units.zh: 平斷法獄，多所全宥，天下皆稱仁。
units.en: In judging legal cases he often spared lives; all under Heaven called him humane.
units.literal: In leveling and deciding legal cases he often fully pardoned; all under Heaven called him humane.

units.zh: 性寬和容衆，喜慍不形於色。
units.en: By nature magnanimous and accommodating, pleasure and anger never showed on his face.
units.literal: By nature magnanimous and accommodating the multitude, pleasure and anger never showed on his face.

units.zh: 引納才學之士，賞愛無倦。
units.en: He drew in men of talent and learning and cherished them without tiring.
units.literal: He drew in talented and learned men and cherished and rewarded without tiring.

units.zh: 恒自討論篇籍，或與學士商榷古今；
units.en: He constantly discussed texts himself, or weighed past and present with academicians;
units.literal: He constantly himself discussed books and records, or with academicians weighed past and present;

units.zh: 閒則繼以文章著述，率以爲常。
units.en: in leisure he wrote, taking composition as his daily habit.
units.literal: in leisure he followed with literary composition and writing, taking it as his constant way.

units.zh: 于時東宮有書幾三萬卷，名才並集，文學之盛，晉、宋以來未之有也。
units.en: The Eastern Palace then held nearly thirty thousand volumes; eminent talents gathered; literary brilliance unmatched since Jin and Song.
units.literal: At that time the Eastern Palace had books approaching thirty thousand volumes; famous talents all gathered; the flourishing of letters had not been seen since Jin and Song.

units.zh: 性愛山水，於玄圃穿築，更立亭館，與朝士名素者遊其中。
units.en: He loved landscape; in the Mystic Garden he excavated and built pavilions and lodges, roaming with noted courtiers.
units.literal: He loved mountains and waters; in the Mystic Garden he dug and built, further establishing pavilions and lodges, roaming there with court gentlemen of established name.

units.zh: 嘗泛舟後池，番禺侯軌盛稱「此中宜奏女樂。」
units.en: Once boating on the rear pool, the Marquis of Panyu Gui said, "This is the place for female musicians."
units.literal: Once he floated on the rear pool; the Marquis of Panyu Gui greatly praised, "Here one ought to present female music."

units.zh: 太子不答，詠左思《招隱詩》曰：「何必絲與竹，山水有清音。」
units.en: The crown prince did not answer but recited Zuo Si's "Summoning the Recluse": "Why silk and bamboo? Mountains and waters have clear sound."
units.literal: The crown prince did not answer but chanted Zuo Si's "Summoning the Recluse": "Why need silk and bamboo? Mountains and waters have clear sound."

units.zh: 侯慚而止。
units.en: The marquis, ashamed, fell silent.
units.literal: The marquis, ashamed, stopped.

units.zh: 出宮二十餘年，不畜聲樂。
units.en: For more than twenty years after leaving the palace he kept no musicians.
units.literal: For more than twenty years after leaving the palace he kept no music.

units.zh: 少時，敕賜太樂女妓一部，略非所好。
units.en: In youth an edict granted him a troupe of imperial music girls—barely to his taste.
units.literal: In youth an edict granted him one troupe of the Grand Music Office's female performers—barely what he favored.

units.zh: 普通中，大軍北討，京師穀貴，太子因命菲衣減膳，改常饌爲小食。
units.en: During Putong the great army marched north, grain in the capital grew dear, and the crown prince ordered plain dress and frugal meals, changing his usual fare to small repasts.
units.literal: In Putong, the great army campaigned north; in the capital grain was dear; the crown prince therefore ordered plain clothes and reduced meals, changing the usual fare to small repasts.

units.zh: 每霖雨積雪，遣腹心左右，周行閭巷，視貧困家，有流離道路，密加振賜。
units.en: Whenever rain or snow lingered, he sent trusted aides through lanes and alleys to find the poor and those wandering the roads and secretly gave relief.
units.literal: Whenever long rain accumulated snow, he sent trusted intimates left and right to circle the lanes and alleys, viewing poor households; where any wandered the roads, he secretly added relief and gifts.

units.zh: 又出主衣綿帛，多作襦袴，冬月以施貧凍。
units.en: He also issued palace silk and cloth, made many jackets and trousers, and in winter gave them to the poor and cold.
units.literal: He also issued the palace's silk and cloth, making many jackets and trousers, in winter months giving them to the poor and frozen.

units.zh: 若死亡無可以斂者，爲備棺槥。
units.en: For those who died with nothing to enshroud them, he provided coffins.
units.literal: If any died with nothing to enshroud them, he prepared coffins.

units.zh: 每聞遠近百姓賦役勤苦，輒斂容色。
units.en: Whenever he heard of the people's tax and corvée burdens near or far, his face grew grave.
units.literal: Whenever he heard that common people far and near suffered bitter labor from taxes and corvée, he immediately composed his countenance.

units.zh: 常以戶口未實，重於勞擾。
units.en: He constantly worried that household registers were incomplete and that labor pressed too hard.
units.literal: He constantly took household registers as not yet full and weighed heavily on labor and disturbance.

units.zh: 吳興郡屢以水災失收，有上言當漕大瀆以瀉浙江。
units.en: Wuxing commandery repeatedly lost its harvest to floods; a memorial proposed dredging the Grand Canal to drain the Zhe River.
units.literal: Wuxing commandery repeatedly because of flood disaster lost harvest; someone memorialized that the Grand Canal should be dredged to drain into the Zhe River.

units.zh: 中大通二年春，詔遣前交州刺史王弁假節，發吳郡、吳興、義興三郡民丁就役。
units.en: In spring of Zhongdatong year two an edict sent former Inspector of Jiaozhou Wang Bian with credentials to levy labor from Wu, Wuxing, and Yixing commanderies.
units.literal: In spring of the second year of Zhongdatong, an edict sent former Inspector of Jiaozhou Wang Bian with credentials to mobilize civilian labor from the three commanderies Wu, Wuxing, and Yixing for the work.

units.zh: 太子上疏曰：「伏聞當發王弁等上東三郡民丁，開漕溝渠，導泄震澤，使吳興一境，無復水災，誠矜恤之至仁，經略之遠旨。
units.en: The crown prince memorialized: "I hear Wang Bian and others are to levy labor from the three eastern commanderies, open canals, drain Zhen Marsh, and end floods in Wuxing commandery—truly utmost humane care and far-sighted policy.
units.literal: The crown prince memorialized: "I hear that Wang Dan and others are to be sent to mobilize civilian labor from the three eastern commanderies, open and dredge canals and ditches, guide and release Zhen Marsh, so that within Wu commandery there will never again be flood disaster—truly the utmost humane care and a far-reaching plan of statecraft.

units.zh: 暫勞永逸，必獲後利。
units.en: Temporary toil for lasting ease will surely bring later profit.
units.literal: Temporary labor for lasting ease—surely afterward benefit will be obtained.

units.zh: 未萌難覩，竊有愚懷。
units.en: What has not yet sprouted is hard to foresee; I venture a humble thought.
units.literal: What is not yet sprouted is hard to see; I venture a foolish thought.

units.zh: 所聞吳興累年失收，民頗流移。
units.en: I hear Wuxing commandery has lost harvest year after year and many people have wandered away.
units.literal: What I hear is that Wu commandery for successive years has lost harvest and the people have quite wandered away.

units.zh: 吳郡十城，亦不全熟。
units.en: Of Wu commandery's ten cities, not all ripened fully.
units.literal: Of Wu commandery's ten cities, not all fully ripened.

units.zh: 唯義興去秋有稔，復非常役之民。
units.en: Only Yixing had a full harvest last autumn, and even there the people are not those of ordinary corvée.
units.literal: Only Yixing last autumn had a full harvest, yet again not people of ordinary corvée.

units.zh: 卽日東境穀稼猶貴，劫盜屢起，在所有司，不皆聞奏。
units.en: Just now grain in the eastern region is still dear and banditry keeps arising; not every office reports it.
units.literal: Just now in the eastern region grain is still dear and robbery repeatedly arises; those in office everywhere do not all hear and report.

units.zh: 今征戍未歸，強丁疏少，此雖小舉，竊恐難合，吏一呼門，動爲民蠹。
units.en: Now the garrisons have not returned and strong men are few; though this is a small levy, I fear it will not cohere—one shout from an official at the door becomes a plague on the people.
units.literal: Now the expedition garrisons have not returned and strong men are few and scattered; though this is a small mobilization, I fear it will be hard to combine—one call from an official at the door and it moves as a plague on the people.

units.zh: 又出丁之處，遠近不一，比得齊集，已妨蠶農。
units.en: Also the places levying labor lie at uneven distances; by the time men are gathered, silkworm season is already harmed.
units.literal: Also the places sending out labor are far and near not one; by the time they are gathered together, silkworm farming is already harmed.

units.zh: 去年稱爲豊歲，公私未能足食；
units.en: Last year was called abundant, yet public and private stores were still not full;
units.literal: Last year was called a abundant year, yet public and private could not yet fully eat;

units.zh: 如復今茲失業，慮恐爲弊更深。
units.en: if this year loses livelihood again, I fear the harm will go deeper.
units.literal: if again this year loses livelihood, I fear the harm will be deeper.

units.zh: 且草竊多伺候民間虛實，若善人從役，則抄盜彌增，吳興未受其益，內地已罹其弊。
units.en: Moreover bandits often watch whether the people are weak or strong; if good men are conscripted, robbery only increases—Wuxing commandery will not yet gain, while the interior will already suffer.
units.literal: Moreover grass bandits often watch the people's emptiness and fullness; if good people go to corvée, then robbery and plunder increase all the more—Wu commandery will not yet receive the benefit, while the interior will already suffer the harm.

units.zh: 不審可得權停此功，待優實以不？
units.en: Might this work be paused for now until prosperity returns?
units.literal: I do not know whether this work may be temporarily halted, to wait until prosperity is full or not?

units.zh: 聖心垂矜黎庶，神量久已有在。
units.en: The sovereign heart cherishes the common people; divine foresight already has its place.
units.literal: The sage heart bends in pity on the black-haired people; divine measure long since already has its place.

units.zh: 臣意見庸淺，不識事宜，苟有愚心，願得上啓。」
units.en: My views are shallow and I scarcely grasp affairs of state; yet if I may offer whatever poor counsel I have, I beg leave to submit it."
units.literal: Your servant's views are shallow and dull, ignorant of what the times require; if there is any foolish thought, I wish to present it above."

units.zh: 高祖優詔以喻焉。
units.en: Gaozu replied with a gracious edict explaining his intent.
units.literal: Gaozu issued a gracious edict to explain his intent.

units.zh: 太子孝謹天至，每入朝，未五鼓便守城門開。
units.en: The crown prince was naturally filial and dutiful; before the fifth watch each morning he was already waiting at the city gate for it to open.
units.literal: The crown prince was filial, careful, and heaven-endowed in nature; each time he entered court, before the fifth watch he was already waiting at the city gate for it to open.

units.zh: 東宮雖燕居內殿，一坐一起，恒向西南面臺。
units.en: Even in the Eastern Palace's inner halls at ease, he always faced southwest toward the terrace whenever he sat or rose.
units.literal: Though residing at leisure in the inner halls of the Eastern Palace, with every sitting and rising he always faced southwest toward the terrace.

units.zh: 宿被召當入，危坐達旦。
units.en: When summoned the night before an audience, he sat upright until dawn.
units.literal: If summoned to enter on the eve before, he sat upright through until dawn.

units.zh: 三年三月，寢疾。
units.en: In the third year, third month, he fell ill and took to his bed.
units.literal: In the third year, third month, he took to his bed with illness.

units.zh: 恐貽高祖憂，敕參問，輒自力手書啓。
units.en: Lest he burden Gaozu with worry, he had his attendants questioned but always wrote memorials by hand himself.
units.literal: Fearing to burden Gaozu with worry, he ordered his attendants questioned and always personally wrote memorials by hand.

units.zh: 及稍篤，左右欲啓聞，猶不許，曰「云何令至尊知我如此惡」，因便嗚咽。
units.en: As the illness worsened, his attendants wished to report it, but he forbade them, saying, "How can I let His Majesty know I am so gravely ill?" and wept.
units.literal: When his illness grew somewhat severe, those beside him wished to report it, but he still would not allow it, saying "How could I let the Supreme Sovereign know I am so gravely ill," and thereupon sobbed.

units.zh: 四月乙巳薨，時年三十一。
units.en: On yisi of the fourth month he died, aged thirty-one.
units.literal: On yisi of the fourth month he passed away, age thirty-one.

units.zh: 高祖幸東宮，臨哭盡哀。
units.en: Gaozu came to the Eastern Palace and wept there with full grief.
units.literal: Gaozu visited the Eastern Palace and mourned there with full grief.

units.zh: 詔斂以袞冕。
units.en: By edict he was to be enshrouded in full imperial mourning dress.
units.literal: Edict: bury him in full imperial mourning dress.

units.zh: 諡曰昭明。
units.en: His posthumous name was Zhaoming, "Luminous."
units.literal: Posthumous name Zhaoming.

units.zh: 五月庚寅，葬安寧陵。
units.en: On gengyin of the fifth month he was buried at Anning Mausoleum.
units.literal: On gengyin of the fifth month he was buried at Anning Mausoleum.

units.zh: 詔司徒左長史王筠爲哀冊文曰：
units.en: An edict charged Wang Yun, Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education, to compose the funeral elegy. It read:
units.literal: Edict ordered Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education Wang Yun to compose the lamentation text, saying:

units.zh: 蜃輅俄軒，龍驂跼步；
units.en: The shell-bedecked carriage rises; dragon-harnessed steeds pace in solemn tread;
units.literal: The clam-shell carriage swiftly lifts; dragon-trained steeds step in constrained pace;

units.zh: 羽翿前驅，雲旂北御。
units.en: feathered fans lead the way; cloud banners bear him north.
units.literal: feather fans proceed before; cloud banners drive northward.

units.zh: 皇帝哀繼明之寢耀，痛嗣德之殂芳；
units.en: The emperor mourns his heir's fading radiance and the withering of a successor's virtue;
units.literal: The emperor mourns the waning radiance of the heir apparent, grieves the withering fragrance of the successor's virtue;

units.zh: 御武帳而淒慟，臨甲觀而增傷。
units.en: he stands desolate beneath the martial canopy; sorrow deepens before the armored watchtower.
units.literal: before the martial canopy he is desolate in grief; before the armored watchtower his sorrow deepens.

units.zh: 式稽令典，載揚鴻烈；
units.en: He consults the established canon and raises his great merit;
units.literal: Consulting the established canon, he raises the great merit;

units.zh: 詔撰德於旌旒，永傳徽於舞綴。
units.en: an edict commands his virtue inscribed on the pennants, his emblem forever borne in the dance tassels.
units.literal: edict commands virtue to be written on the pennants, that his emblem may forever be transmitted in the dance tassels.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: The text reads:
units.literal: The text says:

units.zh: 式載明兩，實惟少陽；
units.en: He bore the twin luminaries—truly the lesser yang;
units.literal: He bore the twin luminaries of sun and moon—truly the lesser yang;

units.zh: 旣稱上嗣，且曰元良。
units.en: already hailed as chief heir, and named the primary worthy.
units.literal: already called the chief heir, and also named the primary worthy.

units.zh: 儀天比峻，儷景騰光；
units.en: His bearing matched heaven's height; his splendor rivaled the sun's light;
units.literal: His bearing matched heaven's height, his splendor rivaled the sun's;

units.zh: 奏祀延福，守器傳芳。
units.en: he offered sacrifice to extend blessing and guarded the vessel to transmit his line.
units.literal: he presented sacrifices to extend blessing, guarded the vessel to transmit fragrance.

units.zh: 睿哲膺期，旦暮斯在；
units.en: Sagely wisdom received its season; at dawn and dusk alike he stood ready;
units.literal: Sagely wisdom received its season; dawn and dusk alike he stood ready;

units.zh: 外弘莊肅，內含和愷。
units.en: outwardly solemn, inwardly harmonious and at ease.
units.literal: outwardly he displayed solemn dignity, inwardly he held harmony and ease.

units.zh: 識洞機深，量苞瀛海；
units.en: His insight pierced fate's subtle workings; his measure embraced the seas within their shores;
units.literal: His insight pierced the subtle workings of fate; his measure embraced the seas within their shores;

units.zh: 立德不器，至功弗宰。
units.en: he established virtue beyond mere vessel, achievement beyond mere stewardship.
units.literal: establishing virtue beyond mere vessel, supreme achievement beyond mere stewardship.

units.zh: 寬綽居心，溫恭成性，循時孝友，率由嚴敬。
units.en: Broad-mindedness dwelt in his heart; warmth and reverence formed his nature; in season he showed filial piety and brotherhood, guided by strict respect.
units.literal: Broad-mindedness dwelt in his heart, warmth and reverence formed his nature; following the seasons he showed filial piety and brotherhood, guided by strict respect.

units.zh: 咸有種德，惠和齊聖；
units.en: All had planted virtue; kindness and harmony joined in sagely union;
units.literal: All had planted virtue; kindness and harmony joined in sagely union;

units.zh: 三善遞宣，萬國同慶。
units.en: the three excellences passed in succession, and ten thousand states rejoiced together.
units.literal: the three excellences passed in succession, ten thousand states shared in celebration.

units.zh: 軒緯掩精，陰犧弛極；
units.en: The carriage constellations veiled their essence; yin and sacrifice slackened to the limit;
units.literal: The carriage constellations veiled their essence; yin and sacrifice slackened to the limit;

units.zh: 纏哀在疚，殷憂銜恤。
units.en: grief wound about in affliction; deep sorrow held mourning in its breast.
units.literal: grief wound about in affliction, deep sorrow held mourning in its breast.

units.zh: 孺泣無時，蔬饘不溢；
units.en: Childlike weeping without cease; plain gruel scarcely touched his lips;
units.literal: Childlike weeping without cease, plain gruel not overflowing;

units.zh: 禫遵踰月，哀號未畢。
units.en: mourning rites passed beyond a month, yet cries of grief had not ceased.
units.literal: the end of mourning followed beyond a month, yet cries of grief had not ceased.

units.zh: 實惟監撫，亦嗣郊禋；
units.en: Truly he oversaw instruction and also succeeded in suburban sacrifice;
units.literal: Truly he oversaw instruction, and also succeeded in suburban sacrifice;

units.zh: 問安肅肅，視膳恂恂。
units.en: he inquired after well-being with solemn care and attended meals with earnest diligence.
units.literal: inquiring after well-being with solemn care, attending meals with earnest diligence.

units.zh: 金華玉璪，玄駟班輪；
units.en: Golden flowers and jade insignia; dark steeds in ordered wheels;
units.literal: Golden flowers and jade insignia, dark steeds in ordered wheels;

units.zh: 隆家幹國，主祭安民。
units.en: upholding house and state, presiding over sacrifice and securing the people.
units.literal: upholding the house and sustaining the state, presiding over sacrifice and securing the people.

units.zh: 光奉成務，萬機是理；
units.en: Brilliantly he undertook established tasks; ten thousand affairs he governed with reason;
units.literal: Brilliantly he undertook established tasks; ten thousand affairs were governed by reason;

units.zh: 矜慎庶獄，勤恤關市。
units.en: he showed compassion in criminal cases and diligently cared for the frontier markets.
units.literal: showing compassion in criminal cases, diligently caring for the frontier markets.

units.zh: 誠存隱惻，容無慍喜；
units.en: Sincerity dwelt in hidden sympathy; his bearing held no anger or delight;
units.literal: Sincerity dwelt in hidden sympathy; his bearing held no anger or delight;

units.zh: 殷勤博施，綢繆恩紀。
units.en: diligent and generous in bestowing favor, closely woven in bonds of grace.
units.literal: diligent and generous in bestowing favor, closely woven in bonds of grace.

units.zh: 爰初敬業，離經斷句；
units.en: From the first he revered his studies, parsing the classics line by line;
units.literal: From the first he revered his studies, departing from the classics to parse the sentences;

units.zh: 奠爵崇師，卑躬待傅。
units.en: he set out the wine cup to honor his teacher and bowed low to await his tutor.
units.literal: setting out the wine cup to honor his teacher, bowing low to await his tutor.

units.zh: 甯資導習，匪勞審諭；
units.en: He relied on guidance and practice, not on laborious repeated instruction;
units.literal: He relied on guidance and practice, not on laborious repeated instruction;

units.zh: 博約是司，時敏斯務。
units.en: breadth and restraint were his charge; timely diligence his task.
units.literal: breadth and restraint were his charge; timely diligence his task.

units.zh: 辨究空微，思探幾賾；
units.en: He discriminated emptiness and the subtle and probed the hidden and recondite;
units.literal: Discriminating inquiry into emptiness and the subtle, thought probing the hidden and recondite;

units.zh: 馳神圖緯，研精爻畫。
units.en: his spirit ranged through charts and weft-lines, refining the hexagrams' tracings.
units.literal: his spirit ranged through charts and weft-lines, refining the hexagrams' tracings.

units.zh: 沈吟典禮，優遊方冊；
units.en: He pondered the classics of ritual and wandered at ease through the square tablets of texts;
units.literal: He pondered the classics of ritual, wandered at ease through the square tablets of texts;

units.zh: 饜飫膏腴，含咀肴核。
units.en: sated with rich marrow, tasting and chewing the kernels of learning.
units.literal: sated with rich marrow, tasting and chewing the kernels of learning.

units.zh: 括囊流略，包舉藝文；
units.en: He bound flowing outlines in a pouch and embraced literary arts;
units.literal: He bound the flowing outlines in a pouch, embraced and raised up literary arts;

units.zh: 遍該緗素，殫極丘墳。
units.en: comprehensively covering silk and plain, exhausting the mounds and tombs of antiquity.
units.literal: comprehensively covering silk and plain, exhausting the mounds and tombs of antiquity.

units.zh: 勝帙充積，儒墨區分；
units.en: Victorious volumes piled high; Confucian and Mohist schools distinguished;
units.literal: Victorious volumes piled high; Confucian and Mohist schools distinguished;

units.zh: 瞻河闡訓，望魯揚芬。
units.en: gazing upon the River to unfold the teaching, looking to Lu to raise its fragrance.
units.literal: gazing upon the River to unfold the teaching, looking to Lu to raise its fragrance.

units.zh: 吟詠性靈，豈惟薄伎；
units.en: Chanting and singing the nature of the spirit—was it only a slight skill?
units.literal: Chanting and singing the nature of the spirit—was it only a slight skill?

units.zh: 屬詞婉約，緣情綺靡。
units.en: His compositions were graceful and restrained, following feeling into exquisite beauty.
units.literal: His compositions were graceful and restrained, following feeling into exquisite beauty.

units.zh: 字無點竄，筆不停紙；
units.en: Not a dot to alter in his characters; his brush never paused on the paper;
units.literal: Not a dot to alter in his characters, his brush never paused on the paper;

units.zh: 壯思泉流，清章雲委。
units.en: bold thought flowed like a spring; clear chapters piled like clouds.
units.literal: bold thought flowed like a spring, clear chapters piled like clouds.

units.zh: 總覽時才，網羅英茂；
units.en: He surveyed the talents of the age and netted the flourishing elite;
units.literal: He surveyed the talents of the age and netted the flourishing elite;

units.zh: 學窮優洽，辭歸繁富。
units.en: his learning exhausted thorough mastery; his words returned to rich abundance.
units.literal: learning exhausted thorough mastery, words returned to rich abundance.

units.zh: 或擅談叢，或稱文囿；
units.en: Some excelled in discourse; some were praised in the gardens of letters;
units.literal: Some excelled in the thickets of discourse, some were praised in the gardens of letters;

units.zh: 四友推德，七子慚秀。
units.en: the four friends promoted virtue; the seven masters blushed at his excellence.
units.literal: the four friends promoted virtue, the seven masters blushed at his excellence.

units.zh: 望苑招賢，華池愛客；
units.en: The imperial park recruited worthies; the flowery pool cherished guests;
units.literal: The imperial park recruited worthies, the flowery pool cherished guests;

units.zh: 託乘同舟，連輿接席。
units.en: riding together in the same carriage, linked chariots with adjoining seats.
units.literal: riding together in the same carriage, linked chariots with adjoining seats.

units.zh: 摛文掞藻，飛𨢩汎醳；
units.en: Unfolding words and displaying ornament, flying goblets and floating brew;
units.literal: Unfolding words and displaying ornament, flying goblets and floating brew;

units.zh: 恩隆置醴，賞逾賜璧。
units.en: favor grand as setting out the wine; reward surpassing the gift of jade disks.
units.literal: favor grand as setting out the wine, reward surpassing the gift of jade disks.

units.zh: 徽風遐被，盛業日新；
units.en: His emblematic wind reached far; his flourishing work renewed day by day;
units.literal: His emblematic wind reached far; his flourishing work renewed day by day;

units.zh: 仁器非重，德輶易遵。
units.en: the vessel of benevolence was not heavy; the carriage of virtue easy to follow.
units.literal: the vessel of benevolence was not heavy, the carriage of virtue easy to follow.

units.zh: 澤流兆庶，福降百神；
units.en: His favor flowed to the myriad people; blessing descended on the hundred spirits;
units.literal: His favor flowed to the myriad people; blessing descended on the hundred spirits;

units.zh: 四方慕義，天下歸仁。
units.en: the four quarters admired righteousness; all under heaven returned to benevolence.
units.literal: the four quarters admired righteousness, all under heaven returned to benevolence.

units.zh: 雲物告徵，祲沴褰象；
units.en: Clouds and creatures proclaimed omens; baleful vapors lifted their images;
units.literal: Clouds and creatures proclaimed omens; baleful vapors lifted their images;

units.zh: 星霾恒耀，山頹朽壤。
units.en: stars dimmed the constant radiance; mountains collapsed into rotting earth.
units.literal: stars dimmed the constant radiance, mountains collapsed into rotting earth.

units.zh: 靈儀上賓，德音長往；
units.en: His numinous bearing ascended on high; his virtuous voice departed far;
units.literal: His numinous bearing ascended as guest on high; his virtuous voice departed far;

units.zh: 具僚無廕，諮承安仰。
units.en: the assembled officials have no shade; whom may they consult and on whom rely?
units.literal: the assembled officials have no shade; whom may they consult and on whom rely?

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 皇情悼愍，切心纏痛；
units.en: The emperor's heart is stricken with grief, wound about in pain;
units.literal: The emperor's heart is stricken with grief, his heart wound about in pain;

units.zh: 胤嗣長號，跗萼增慟。
units.en: the heir's descendants wail long; calyx and petals add to the grief.
units.literal: the heir's descendants wail long, the calyx and petals add to the grief.

units.zh: 慕結親遊，悲動氓衆；
units.en: Longing binds close companions; grief moves the common people;
units.literal: Longing binds close companions, grief moves the common people;

units.zh: 憂若殄邦，懼同折棟。
units.en: sorrow as if the state were perishing; fear as if the ridgepole were breaking.
units.literal: sorrow as if the state were perishing, fear as if the ridgepole were breaking.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 首夏司開，麥秋紀節；
units.en: At the head of summer the season opens; the wheat harvest marks its node;
units.literal: At the head of summer the season opens; the wheat harvest marks its node;

units.zh: 容衛徒警，菁華委絕。
units.en: the guard of his countenance is suddenly alert; the flowering splendor cast away and ended.
units.literal: the guard of his countenance is suddenly alert, the flowering splendor cast away and ended.

units.zh: 書幌空張，談筵罷設；
units.en: The book curtains hang empty; the discourse mats are dismantled;
units.literal: The book curtains hang empty, the discourse mats are dismantled;

units.zh: 虛饋饛饛，孤燈翳翳。
units.en: empty offerings of steaming grain; a lone lamp dim and faint.
units.literal: empty offerings of steaming grain, a lone lamp dim and faint.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 簡辰請日，筮合龜貞。
units.en: The day was chosen by calendrical reckoning; tortoise and milfoil divination agreed in auspice;
units.literal: The day was chosen by calendrical reckoning, the divination of tortoise and milfoil agreed in auspice;

units.zh: 幽埏夙啓，玄宮獻成。
units.en: the dark precinct long since opened; the hidden palace presented complete.
units.literal: the dark precinct long since opened, the hidden palace presented complete.

units.zh: 武校齊列，文物增明。
units.en: Martial guards aligned in ranks; civil regalia increased in splendor.
units.literal: Martial guards aligned in ranks, civil regalia increased in splendor.

units.zh: 昔遊漳滏，賓從無聲；
units.en: Once he roamed the Zhang and Fu rivers, guests and followers without sound;
units.literal: Once he roamed the Zhang and Fu rivers, guests and followers without sound;

units.zh: 今歸郊郭，徒禦相驚。
units.en: now returning to the outer suburbs, attendants and chariots startle one another.
units.literal: now returning to the outer suburbs, attendants and chariots startle one another.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 背絳闕以遠徂，轥青門而徐轉；
units.en: Turning his back on the crimson gate-tower he departs far; rolling past the Green Gate he turns slowly;
units.literal: Turning his back on the crimson gate-tower he departs far; rolling past the Green Gate he turns slowly;

units.zh: 指馳道而詎前，望國都而不踐。
units.en: pointing along the imperial road yet stopping short before it, gazing toward the capital yet not treading it.
units.literal: pointing along the imperial road yet stopping short before it, gazing toward the capital yet not treading it.

units.zh: 陵脩阪之威夷，溯平原之悠緬；
units.en: The mound ascends the steep slope in awesome dignity; the plain stretches back in distant expanse;
units.literal: The mound ascends the steep slope in awesome dignity, the plain stretches back in distant expanse;

units.zh: 驥蹀足以酸嘶，挽淒鏘而流泫。
units.en: the thoroughbred's hooves enough to wring the heart with bitter whinny; mourners' plaintive clank as tears stream down.
units.literal: the thoroughbred's hooves enough to make one ache with its bitter whinny, the mourners' plaintive clank as tears stream down.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 混哀音於簫籟，變愁容於天日；
units.en: Mournful pipes and flutes mingle; grief reshapes the face of heaven and sun;
units.literal: Mingling mournful sound with reed-pipes and flutes, changing grief's countenance upon heaven and sun;

units.zh: 雖夏木之森陰，返寒林之蕭瑟。
units.en: though summer trees still stand in dense shade, all returns to the bleak cold of winter groves.
units.literal: though summer trees stand in dense shade, they return to the bleak cold of winter groves.

units.zh: 旣將反而復疑，如有求而遂失；
units.en: Turning homeward yet doubting again, as though he had sought something and then lost it;
units.literal: Already turning back yet doubting again, as if he sought something and then lost it;

units.zh: 謂天地其無心，遽永潛於容質。
units.en: Deeming heaven and earth heartless, he suddenly sank forever from mortal sight.
units.literal: Deeming heaven and earth without heart, he suddenly plunged forever into concealment of his bodily form.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 卽玄宮之冥漠，安神寢之清閟；
units.en: He entered the hidden palace's dark silence and laid his spirit to rest in clear seclusion;
units.literal: Approaching the dark obscurity of the hidden palace, settling his spirit's rest in clear seclusion;

units.zh: 傳聲華於懋典，觀德業於徽諡。
units.en: His fame is handed down in grand rite; his virtue is read in his posthumous name;
units.literal: Transmitting his sounding glory through splendid canon, viewing his virtue's achievement in posthumous title;

units.zh: 懸忠貞於日月，播鴻名於天地；
units.en: Loyalty and constancy hang with sun and moon; his great name spreads through heaven and earth;
units.literal: Hang loyalty and constancy upon sun and moon, spread great fame through heaven and earth;

units.zh: 惟小臣之紀言，實含毫而無愧。
units.en: Only this humble minister's written record—truly pen in hand without shame.
units.literal: Only this petty minister's record of words—truly holding the brush without shame.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！
units.en: Alas, how mournful!
units.literal: Alas, how mournful!

units.zh: 太子仁德素著，及薨，朝野惋愕。
units.en: The crown prince's humane virtue was long renowned; at his death court and countryside alike were stricken with grief.
units.literal: The crown prince's humane virtue had long been manifest; when he passed away, court and commoners were stunned with regret.

units.zh: 京師男女，奔走宮門，號泣滿路。
units.en: Men and women of the capital rushed to the palace gates, wailing until the roads were full.
units.literal: Men and women of the capital ran to the palace gates, wailing and filling the roads.

units.zh: 四方氓庶，及疆徼之民，聞喪皆慟哭。
units.en: Commoners in every quarter, even people on the frontier marches, wept bitterly when they heard of the mourning.
units.literal: Common folk of the four quarters, and people of the frontier marches, hearing of the mourning all wept bitterly.

units.zh: 所著文集二十卷；
units.en: His collected literary works ran to twenty juan;
units.literal: His collected literary works numbered twenty juan;

units.zh: 又撰古今典誥文言，爲《正序》十卷；
units.en: he also compiled ancient and modern edicts in literary language as Correct Sequence in ten juan;
units.literal: he also compiled ancient and modern canonical edicts in literary language, making Correct Sequence in ten juan;

units.zh: 五言詩之善者，爲《文章英華》二十卷；
units.en: his finest five-character poems he gathered as Literary Flowers in twenty juan;
units.literal: the finest of his five-character poems he made Literary Flowers in twenty juan;

units.zh: 《文選》三十卷。
units.en: Literary Selections in thirty juan.
units.literal: Literary Selections in thirty juan.

units.zh: 哀太子大器，字仁宗，太宗嫡長子也。
units.en: Lamented Crown Prince Daqi, styled Renzong, was Taizong's eldest son by the chief consort.
units.literal: Lamented Crown Prince Daqi, styled Renzong, was Emperor Taizong's eldest son by the chief consort.

units.zh: 普通四年五月丁酉生。
units.en: He was born in the fifth month of Putong year 4, on dingyou day.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Putong year 4, day dingyou, he was born.

units.zh: 中大通四年，封宣城郡王，食邑二千戶。
units.en: In Zhongdatong year 4 he was made Prince of Xuancheng commandery with a fief of two thousand households.
units.literal: In Zhongdatong year 4 he was enfeoffed Prince of Xuancheng commandery, fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 尋爲侍中、中衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: Soon he was made Attendant-in-Ordinary and Central Guard general, with one set of martial music granted.
units.literal: Soon he became Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of the Central Guard, with one set of martial music granted.

units.zh: 大同四年，授使持節、都督揚、徐二州諸軍事、中軍大將軍、揚州刺史，侍中如故。
units.en: In Datong year 4 he was made Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yang and Xu military affairs, Central Army grand general, and Governor of Yangzhou, remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: In Datong year 4 he was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander of all military affairs of Yang and Xu provinces, Grand General of the Central Army, and Governor of Yangzhou, Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.

units.zh: 太清二年十月，侯景寇京邑，敕太子爲臺內大都督。
units.en: In the tenth month of Taqing year 2 Hou Jing attacked the capital; by edict the crown prince became Grand Commander within the Terrace.
units.literal: In the tenth month of Taqing year 2, Hou Jing raided the capital; an edict made the crown prince Grand Commander within the Terrace.

units.zh: 三年五月，太宗卽位。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 3 Taizong took the throne.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, Taizong took the throne.

units.zh: 六月丁亥，立爲皇太子。
units.en: On dinghai of the sixth month he was established crown prince.
units.literal: On dinghai of the sixth month he was established as crown prince.

units.zh: 大寶二年八月，賊景廢太宗，將害太子，時賊黨稱景命召太子，太子方講《老子》，將欲下床，而刑人掩至。
units.en: In the eighth month of Dabao year 2 the rebel Jing deposed Taizong and meant to kill the crown prince; Jing's men claimed an order from Jing summoned him. The crown prince was lecturing on the Laozi and was rising from his couch when executioners burst in.
units.literal: In the eighth month of Dabao year 2 the rebel Jing deposed Taizong and was about to kill the crown prince; at that time Jing's partisans claimed Jing's order summoned the crown prince. The crown prince was lecturing on the Laozi and was about to rise from the couch when the executioners suddenly arrived.

units.zh: 太子顏色不變，徐曰：「久知此事，嗟其晚耳。」
units.en: The crown prince's face did not change; he said calmly, "I have long known this—only that it comes so late."
units.literal: The crown prince's countenance did not change; he said slowly: "I have long known this—alas that it comes so late."

units.zh: 刑者欲以衣帶絞之。
units.en: The executioners meant to strangle him with his sash.
units.literal: The executioners wished to strangle him with his sash.

units.zh: 太子曰：「此不能見殺。」
units.en: The crown prince said, "That will not do to kill me."
units.literal: The crown prince said: "That cannot serve to kill me."

units.zh: 乃指繫帳竿下繩，命取絞之而絕，時年二十八。
units.en: He pointed to the rope on the tent pole and ordered them to take it and strangle him; he was twenty-eight.
units.literal: He then pointed to the rope beneath the tent pole and ordered it taken to strangle him to death; he was then twenty-eight.

units.zh: 太子性寬和，兼神用端嶷，在於賊手，每不屈意。
units.en: By nature the crown prince was mild and harmonious, with a dignified spirit and bearing; even in rebel hands he never bent his will.
units.literal: The crown prince by nature was mild and harmonious, and also of dignified spirit and bearing; in the rebels' hands he never bent his will.

units.zh: 初，侯景西上，攜太子同行，及其敗歸，部伍不復整肅，太子所乘船居後，不及賊衆，左右心腹並勸因此入北。
units.en: At first, when Hou Jing marched west he took the crown prince along; when defeated on his return the ranks were no longer disciplined. The crown prince's boat fell behind the rebel host, and his close attendants all urged him to seize the chance and flee north.
units.literal: At first, when Hou Jing marched west, he took the crown prince with him; when he was defeated and returned, the ranks were no longer in good order. The crown prince's boat lagged behind and could not keep up with the rebel host; his close attendants and trusted followers all urged him to take this chance to flee north.

units.zh: 太子曰：「家國喪敗，志不圖生；
units.en: The crown prince said, "House and state are ruined—I have no wish to live;
units.literal: The crown prince said: "House and state are ruined—I have no thought of living;

units.zh: 主上蒙塵，寧忍違離？
units.en: the sovereign is lost in hardship—how could I bear to leave him?
units.literal: the sovereign suffers dust and hardship—how could I bear to leave him?

units.zh: 吾今逃匿，乃是叛父，非謂避賊。」
units.en: If I flee and hide now, I rebel against my father; it is not merely to avoid bandits."
units.literal: If I flee and hide now, I am rebelling against my father, not merely avoiding bandits."

units.zh: 便涕泗鳴咽，令卽前進。
units.en: He wept aloud and ordered them to press forward at once.
units.literal: Thereupon he wept and sobbed aloud and ordered them to press forward at once.

units.zh: 賊以太子有器度，每常憚之，恐爲後患，故先及禍。
units.en: The rebels, seeing the crown prince's bearing and capacity, always feared him; dreading future trouble, they struck at him first.
units.literal: The rebels, because the crown prince had bearing and capacity, always feared him and, dreading future trouble, struck at him first.

units.zh: 承聖元年四月，追諡哀太子。
units.en: In the fourth month of Chengsheng year 1 he was posthumously titled Lamented Crown Prince.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Chengsheng year 1 he was posthumously titled Lamented Crown Prince.

units.zh: 愍懷太子方矩，字德規，世祖第四子也。
units.en: Crown Prince Minhuai, Fangju, styled Degui, was Shizu's fourth son.
units.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai, Fangju, styled Degui, was Shizu's fourth son.

units.zh: 初封南安縣侯，隨世祖在荊鎮。
units.en: He was first enfeoffed as Marquis of Nan'an county and accompanied Shizu at his Jingzhou garrison.
units.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Marquis of Nan'an county and accompanied Shizu at his Jingzhou garrison.

units.zh: 太清初，爲使持節、督湘郢桂寧成合羅七州諸軍事、鎮南將軍、湘州刺史。
units.en: At the beginning of Taiqing, he became Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in the seven provinces of Xiang, Ying, Gui, Ning, Cheng, He, and Luo, General Who Pacifies the South, and inspector of Xiangzhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of Taiqing, he became Envoy Holding Credentials, commander of military affairs in the seven provinces of Xiang, Ying, Gui, Ning, Cheng, He, and Luo, General Who Pacifies the South, and inspector of Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 尋𢖜爲侍中、中衛將軍，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: He was soon summoned to be Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of the Central Guard, and was granted one corps of drummers and pipers.
units.literal: He was soon summoned to be Attendant-in-Ordinary and General of the Central Guard, and was granted one corps of drummers and pipers.

units.zh: 世祖承制，拜王太子，改名元良。
units.en: When Shizu acted under imperial mandate, he appointed him princely heir and changed his name to Yuanliang.
units.literal: When Shizu acted under imperial mandate, he appointed him princely heir and changed his name to Yuanliang.

units.zh: 承聖元年十一月丙子，立爲皇太子。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Chengsheng 1, on bingzi day, he was established as crown prince.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of Chengsheng 1, on bingzi day, he was established as crown prince.

units.zh: 及西魏師陷荊城，太子與世祖同爲魏人所害。
units.en: When the Western Wei army captured Jingcheng, the crown prince and Shizu were both killed by the Wei.
units.literal: When the Western Wei army captured Jingcheng, the crown prince and Shizu were both killed by the Wei.

units.zh: 太子聰穎，頗有世祖風，而凶暴猜忌。
units.en: The crown prince was clever and keen, much in Shizu's manner, yet fierce, violent, and suspicious.
units.literal: The crown prince was clever and keen, quite in Shizu's manner, yet fierce, violent, and suspicious.

units.zh: 敬帝承制，追諡愍懷太子。
units.en: Emperor Jing, acting on imperial mandate, posthumously titled him Crown Prince Minhuai.
units.literal: Emperor Jing, acting under imperial mandate, posthumously titled him Crown Prince Minhuai.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：孟軻有言：「雞鳴而起，孳孳爲善者，舜之徒也。」
units.en: Yao Cha, Chen Minister of Personnel, said: Mencius says, "Rising at cockcrow to labor in goodness—these are followers of Shun."
units.literal: Yao Cha, Minister of Personnel of Chen, said: Mencius has a saying: "Rising at cockcrow to labor in goodness—these are followers of Shun."

units.zh: 若乃布衣韋帶之士，在於畎畝之中，終日爲之，其利亦已博矣。
units.en: For plain-clothed scholars in field and furrow to labor at it all day, the benefit is already great.
units.literal: If plain-clothed girdled scholars in field and furrow toil at it all day, the benefit is already broad.

units.zh: 況乎處重明之位，居正體之尊，克念無怠，烝烝以孝。
units.en: How much more for one who holds the place of doubled brightness, dwells in the honor of the principal heir, keeps thought without slackness, and advances in filial piety!
units.literal: How much more one who occupies the position of doubled brightness, dwells in the honor of the principal heir, keeps thought without slackness, and advances in filial piety!

units.zh: 大舜之德，其何遠之有哉！
units.en: How far off could the virtue of great Shun be!
units.literal: How far could the virtue of great Shun be!

units.zh: 沖母，梁武帝妹新安穆公主，卒於齊世，武帝以沖偏孤，深所鍾愛。
units.en: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, a sister of Emperor Wu of Liang. She died in Qi times, and the emperor, seeing that Chong had been left partially orphaned, doted on him.
units.literal: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, sister of Emperor Wu of Liang; she died in Qi times, and the Emperor, because Chong was a lone orphan, cherished him deeply.

units.zh: 按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。
units.en: After Liang Wudi's accession he honored his father posthumously as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: According to the note, after Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。
units.en: Wang Chong's biography says his mother was Liang Wudi's sister Princess Xin'an Mu, which matches.
units.literal: The biography of Wang Chong says his mother was Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess Xin'an Mu—this agrees.

units.zh: 王沖 王通弟勱 袁敬兄子樞
units.en: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu
units.literal: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu

units.zh: [2]琳，齊代娶梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，嵭知名。
units.en: Lin, in Qi times, married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess of Yixing long; he had nine sons, all of whom won notice.
units.literal: Lin, in Qi times married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister Princess of Yixing long, had nine sons, and all became renowned.

units.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，队勱令從輦側，所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。
units.en: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs by way of Zhufang; Mo met him as custom required. The emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; at every hill and stream he asked questions, and Mo answered each with historical precedent.
units.literal: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed through Zhufang; Mo greeted him per custom; the Emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; every mountain and river passed, the Emperor inquired; Mo answered each matter with historical precedent.

units.zh: 及明崔甗之謗言，執侯景之奸使，昔人稱孟軻為勇，于文簡公見之。
units.en: When he exposed Cui Yan's slander and seized Hou Jing's treacherous envoy, one can see in Duke Wenjian the courage that earlier men praised in Meng Ke.
units.literal: When he exposed Cui Yan's slanderous words and seized Hou Jing's treacherous envoy, what men of old called Meng Ke's courage can be seen in Duke Wenjian.

units.zh: 溉，〔一〕時梁州刺史陰子春、領軍朱异在焉。
units.en: Collation variant: (Gai), [1] At that time Liang inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and director of the palace guard Zhu Yi were present.
units.literal: Collation variant: (Gai), At that time Liang Inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and Director of the Palace Guard Zhu Yi were present.

units.zh: 子春素知申，即於坐所呼與為對，〔二〕申每有妙思，异觀而奇之，因引申遊處。
units.en: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, [2] Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.
units.literal: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.

units.zh: 梁蕭繹為周軍所逼，遣使告急，且請援。
units.en: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys begging aid.
units.literal: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys reporting emergency and requesting aid.

units.zh: 冬，詔岳為西南道大行臺，統司徒潘相樂等救江陵。
units.en: In winter an edict made Yue grand field headquarters of the southwest circuit, commanding minister of state Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.
units.literal: In winter an edict made Yue Grand Field Headquarters of the Southwest Circuit, commanding Minister of State Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 太宗簡文皇帝諱綱，字世纘，小字六通，高祖第三子，昭明太子母弟也。
units.en: Taizong Emperor Jianwen, personal name Gang, courtesy name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong, was Gaozu's third son and Zhaoming Crown Prince's younger brother by the same mother.
units.literal: The Taizong Emperor Jianwen was tabooed Gang, style name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong; he was the third son of the Gaozu and a uterine younger brother of Crown Prince Zhaoming.

units.zh: 初，太宗見幽縶，題壁自序云：「有梁正士蘭陵蕭世纘，立身行道，終始如一，風雨如晦，雞鳴不已。
units.en: At first, when Taizong was held captive, he wrote on the wall: "I, Xiao Shizuan of Lanling, upright man of Liang, one in conduct from start to finish—though wind and rain darken the sky, the cock crows without cease.
units.literal: At first, when Taizong was imprisoned, he wrote a self-account on the wall, saying: "I, Xiao Shizuan of Lanling, upright man of Liang, in conduct from first to last one—though wind and rain darken the sky, the cock crows without cease.

units.zh: 晉安王綱，文義生知，孝敬自然，威惠外宣，德行內敏，羣后歸美，率土宅心。
units.en: Prince Gang of Jin'an was gifted in letters and principles, naturally filial and respectful, his authority and kindness known abroad and his virtue keen within; the lords praised him and the realm took him to heart.
units.literal: Prince of Jin'an Gang, gifted in letters and right by nature, filial and respectful by instinct, his authority and kindness proclaimed abroad and virtue and conduct keen within, the feudal lords admired him and all the land took him to heart.

units.zh: 明年，三月己丑，王僧辯率前百官奉梓宮升朝堂，世祖追崇為簡文皇帝，廟曰太宗。
units.en: The next year, on jichou in the third month, Wang Senbian led the former hundred officials to raise the coffin to the audience hall; Shizu posthumously honored him as Emperor Jianwen with temple name Taizong.
units.literal: The next year, third month, day jichou, Wang Senbian led the former hundred officials in escorting the coffin up the audience hall; Shizu posthumously honored him as Emperor Jianwen, with temple name Taizong.

units.zh: 五年，封晉安王，食邑八千戶。
units.en: In year 5 he was made Prince of Jin'an with a fief of eight thousand households.
units.literal: In year 5 he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin'an with a fief of eight thousand households.

units.zh: 戊午，侯景遣衛尉卿彭俊、廂公王僧貴率兵入殿，廢太宗為晉安王，幽于永福省。
units.en: On wuwu day Hou Jing sent minister of the guard Peng Jun and palace section commander Wang Senggui with troops into the hall, deposed Taizong as Prince of Jin'an, and imprisoned him in Yongfu Palace.
units.literal: On wuwu, Hou Jing sent Minister of the Guard Peng Jun and Palace Section Commander Wang Senggui to lead troops into the hall, deposed Taizong as Prince of Jin'an, and confined him in Yongfu Palace.

units.zh: 可立為皇太子。」
units.en: He is to be established as crown prince."
units.literal: He may be established as crown prince."

units.zh: 賊偽諡曰明皇帝，廟稱高宗。
units.en: The rebels gave him the posthumous title Bright Emperor and the temple name Gaozong.
units.literal: The rebels gave the posthumous title Bright Emperor and the temple name Gaozong.

units.zh: 辛巳，卽皇帝位。
units.en: On xinsi he took the throne.
units.literal: On xinsi he ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 雅好題詩，其序云：「余七歲有詩癖，長而不倦。」
units.en: He loved poetry by nature; in his preface he wrote, "At seven I had a poetry mania, and as I grew I never tired of it."
units.literal: He loved composing poetry by nature; in his preface he wrote: "At seven I had a poetry mania, and in growing up I never tired of it."

units.zh: 然傷於輕豔，當時號曰「宮體」。
units.en: Yet he was faulted for frivolous ornament, and his age called it the "Palace Style."
units.literal: Yet he was faulted for frivolous ornament, and his age styled this the "Palace Style."

units.zh: 所著《昭明太子傳》五卷，《諸王傳》三十卷，《禮大義》二十卷，《老子義》二十卷，《莊子義》二十卷，《長春義記》一百卷，《法寶連璧》三百卷，並行於世焉。
units.en: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his day.
units.literal: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his time.

units.zh: 博綜儒書，善言玄理。
units.en: He mastered Confucian classics and was skilled in Neo-Daoist discourse.
units.literal: Broadly versed in Confucian books, skilled in discoursing on Dark Learning.

units.zh: 高祖所制《五經講疏》，嘗於玄圃奉述，聽者傾朝野。
units.en: When Gaozu composed his Expositions on the Five Classics, Taizong once lectured on them at the Dark Garden; listeners filled court and countryside.
units.literal: When Gaozu composed Expositions on the Five Classics, Taizong once presented them at the Dark Garden; listeners filled court and countryside.

units.zh: 是歲，丁所生穆貴嬪喪，上表陳解，詔還攝本任。
units.en: That year, when his birth mother Honored Consort Mu died, he asked to resign but was ordered back to his post.
units.literal: That year, on mourning for his birth mother Honored Consort Mu, he submitted a memorial requesting release; an edict ordered him to resume his original duties.

units.zh: 天監二年十月丁未，生於顯陽殿。
units.en: On dingwei in the tenth month of Tianjian 2 he was born in Xianyang Hall.
units.literal: In the tenth month, day dingwei, year 2 of Tianjian, he was born in Xianyang Hall.

units.zh: 旣醉寢，王偉、彭儁進土囊，王修纂坐其上，於是太宗崩於永福省，時年四十九。
units.en: When he was drunk and asleep, Wang Wei and Peng Jun brought in a bag of earth; Wang Xiuzuan sat on it—and Taizong died in Yongfu Palace at the age of forty-nine.
units.literal: When he was drunk and asleep, Wang Wei and Peng Jun brought in a bag of earth; Wang Xiuzuan sat upon it—and thereupon Taizong died in Yongfu Palace, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 太清三年五月丙辰，高祖崩。
units.en: On bingchen in the fifth month of Taiqing 3 Gaozu died.
units.literal: In the fifth month, day bingchen, year 3 of Taiqing, the Gaozu died.

units.zh: 八年，為雲麾將軍，領石頭戍軍事，量置佐吏。
units.en: In year 8 he became General of the Cloud Banner, took charge of Shitou garrison affairs, and had aides appointed as required.
units.literal: In year 8 he was made General of the Cloud Banner, supervising military affairs at the Shitou garrison, with assistant officials appointed as needed.

units.zh: 九年，遷使持節、都督南北兗青徐冀五州諸軍事、宣毅將軍、南兗州刺史。
units.en: In year 9 he was made Bearer of the Staff and commander of the five Yan, Qing, Xu, and Ji provinces, General Who Proclaims Resolution, and South Yanzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 9 he was transferred to Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the five provinces North and South Yan, Qing, Xu, and Ji, made General Who Proclaims Resolution and South Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 十二年，入為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: In year 12 he entered court as General Who Proclaims Grace and intendant of Danyang.
units.literal: In year 12 he entered the capital as General Who Proclaims Grace and Intendant of Danyang.

units.zh: 十三年，出為使持節、都督荊雍梁南北秦益寧七州諸軍事、南蠻校尉、荊州刺史，將軍如故。
units.en: In year 13 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Jing, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, Yi, and Ning, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, and Jingzhou inspector, retaining his generalship.
units.literal: In year 13 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Jing, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, Yi, and Ning, made Colonel of the Southern Barbarians and Jingzhou Inspector, his generalship unchanged.

units.zh: 十四年，徙為都督江州諸軍事、雲麾將軍、江州刺史，持節如故。
units.en: In year 14 he was reassigned commander of Jiangzhou, General of the Cloud Banner, and Jiangzhou inspector, still Bearer of the Staff.
units.literal: In year 14 he was reassigned as Commander over military affairs in Jiangzhou, General of the Cloud Banner and Jiangzhou Inspector, Bearer of the Staff unchanged.

units.zh: 十七年，徵為西中郎將、領石頭戍軍事，尋復為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹，加侍中。
units.en: In year 17 he was recalled as Leader of the Palace Gentlemen of the West with Shitou garrison duties, then again General Who Proclaims Grace and Danyang intendant, with Palace Attendant added.
units.literal: In year 17 he was summoned as Leader of the Palace Gentlemen of the West, supervising the Shitou garrison; soon restored as General Who Proclaims Grace and Intendant of Danyang, additionally made Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 未拜，改授雲麾將軍、南徐州刺史。
units.en: before taking office he was reassigned General of the Cloud Banner and South Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: before assuming the post, he was reassigned as General of the Cloud Banner and South Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 四年，徙為使持節、都督雍梁、南北秦四州郢州之竟陵司州之隨郡諸軍事，平西將軍、寧蠻校尉、雍州刺史。
units.en: In year 4 he was reassigned Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and related districts, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of Pacified Barbarians, and Yongzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 4 he was reassigned as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in Yong and Liang, North and South Qin, the four provinces, Jingzhou's Jingling, and Sizhou's Su commandery, made General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of Pacified Barbarians, and Yongzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 五年，進號安北將軍。
units.en: In year 5 he was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
units.literal: In year 5 he was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.

units.zh: 二年，徵為都督南揚、徐二州諸軍事、驃騎將軍、揚州刺史。
units.en: In year 2 he was recalled as commander of South Yang and Xu, General of Agile Cavalry, and Yangzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 2 he was summoned as Commander over military affairs in South Yang and Xu, made General of Agile Cavalry and Yangzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 七月乙亥，臨軒策拜，以脩繕東宮，權居東府。
units.en: On yihai in the seventh month he was invested at the throne hall; while the Eastern Palace was repaired he lodged temporarily at the Eastern Mansion.
units.literal: On yihai in the seventh month, the enthronement ceremony was held at the imperial hall; because the Eastern Palace was under repair, he temporarily resided at the Eastern Mansion.

units.zh: 普通元年，出為使持節、都督益寧雍梁南北秦沙七州諸軍事、益州刺史；
units.en: In Putong 1 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and Sha, and Yi province inspector;
units.literal: In year 1 of Putong he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, and Sha, and made Yi Province Inspector;

units.zh: 三年四月乙巳，昭明太子薨。
units.en: On yisi in the fourth month of year 3 Crown Prince Zhaoming died.
units.literal: In the fourth month, day yisi, year 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming died.

units.zh: 大寶元年春正月辛亥朔，以國哀不朝會。
units.en: On xinhai, the new-year's day of Dabao 1, national mourning prevented the court assembly.
units.literal: On xinhai, the first day of the first month of spring in year 1 of Dabao, because of national mourning there was no court assembly.

units.zh: 可大赦天下，改太清四年為大寶元年。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed and Taiqing 4 is changed to Dabao 1."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed; Taiqing year 4 is changed to Dabao year 1."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以不造，夙丁閔凶。
units.en: An edict said, "Ill-fated as I am, I have long borne this grief.
units.literal: An edict said: "Our lack of fortune afflicts us; from early we suffered this calamity.

units.zh: 大行皇帝奄棄萬國，攀慕號躃，厝身靡所。
units.en: The late emperor has suddenly left the myriad realms; in longing and wailing I have nowhere to set myself.
units.literal: The late emperor suddenly abandoned the myriad realms; we cling and wail and have nowhere to place ourselves.

units.zh: 猥以寡德，越居民上，煢煢在疚，罔知所託，方賴籓輔，社稷用安。
units.en: With slight virtue I have undeservedly risen above the people; alone in grief I know not whom to trust, and must rely on the feudatories to keep the altars secure.
units.literal: Unworthily with slight virtue we have crossed above the people; alone in anguish we know not where to lean, yet rely on the feudal helpers that the altars may be secure.

units.zh: 謹遵先旨，顧命遺澤，宜加億兆。
units.en: Respectfully following the prior command and the grace of the deathbed charge, the hundred millions should receive added benefit.
units.literal: Respectfully following the prior will and the bequeathed grace of the final charge, benefit should be added for the hundred millions.

units.zh: 可大赦天下。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed for the empire."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed for the empire."

units.zh: 詔曰：「蓋天下者，至公之神器，在昔三五，不獲已而臨蒞之。
units.en: An edict said, "All under Heaven is the sacred vessel of utmost fairness; in antiquity the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors took the throne only when they could not refuse.
